description: Small-domain natural-number power atoms (pow2 and pow_nat) provable in Z3's integer theory by explicit case-splits over the exponent. Complements std/math/pow.mm (pow_small / pow_saturating). The generated file MUST begin with a header comment block (// ======) identifying the module as 'std/math/pow_nat — verified small-domain integer powers'. Comments must be in Japanese to match the surrounding std style. Each atom follows the convention used in std/core.mm: `atom name(params) requires: ...; ensures: ...; body: { ... };`. Do NOT invent new operators, types, or syntax — use only what std/core.mm already uses (checked_add, checked_mul, conditional expressions).

atoms.name: pow2
atoms.description: Power of two for non-negative exponents in {0,..,30}. Explicit branch table keeps Z3's non-linear arithmetic tractable: each branch is a literal constant equal to 2^n. The cap of 30 ensures result fits in i64 with plenty of headroom.

atoms.name: pow_nat
atoms.description: Natural-number integer exponentiation for small bases (base in [0, 10]) and small exponents (exp in [0, 6]). Returns base^exp via explicit case-split over (base, exp); each case is a literal product Z3 can simplify directly.
